brief: A small toy-like carnival trophy placed inside Abbie’s cottage. It is the tappable entrance object that starts the trip to the fair. A playful miniature carnival tent with bunting on a sturdy trophy base; inviting and recognizable as a toy keepsake rather than a realistic sports cup. Proposed design, subject to art review. No baked-in text. This is a room object, distinct from the overland fairground entrance.
styleNotes: For six-year-olds: exuberant 2D children’s illustrated storybook / comic art, thick dark ink outlines, flat vibrant candy colors, hard-edged cel shading, wonky exaggerated proportions, playful oversized props and readable visual gags. No photorealism, realistic landscaping, cinematic lighting or detailed painted textures. Preserve clear small-scale silhouettes.
